CREATE TABLE "public"."outbox_events" (
  "attempt_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "available_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dead_at" timestamptz,
  "event_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "event_type" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "home_id" uuid,
  "last_error_code" character varying(100),
  "last_failed_at" timestamptz,
  "lease_owner" uuid,
  "lease_until" timestamptz,
  "leased_at" timestamptz,
  "occurred_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "processed_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_attempt_count_check" CHECK ((attempt_count >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_error_code_format_check" CHECK (((last_error_code IS NULL) OR ((last_error_code)::text ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,99}$'::text))),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_event_type_format_check" CHECK (((event_type)::text ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*[.][a-z][a-z0-9_]*([.][a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*[.]v[1-9][0-9]*$'::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_lease_completeness_check" CHECK ((((lease_owner IS NULL) AND (leased_at IS NULL) AND (lease_until IS NULL)) OR ((lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AND (leased_at IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_lease_order_check" CHECK (((lease_until IS NULL) OR (lease_until > leased_at))),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_payload_object_check" CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text)),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_terminal_not_leased_check" CHECK ((((processed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL)) OR (lease_owner IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "outbox_events_terminal_state_check" CHECK ((NOT ((processed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (dead_at IS NOT NULL))))
)
CREATE INDEX "outbox_events_claim_idx" ON "public"."outbox_events" ("available_at", "created_at", "event_id") WHERE (((processed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL)))
CREATE INDEX "outbox_events_dead_prune_idx" ON "public"."outbox_events" ("dead_at", "event_id") WHERE ((dead_at IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX "outbox_events_processed_prune_idx" ON "public"."outbox_events" ("processed_at", "event_id") WHERE ((processed_at IS NOT NULL))
